target_customer: Small and mid-sized trade contractors and home service businesses that depend on phone leads
problem: Contractors miss calls while on jobs and lose leads, and traditional call centers are expensive and lack trade knowledge.
business_model: B2B SaaS for contractors, pricing not public
product_category: AI voice and front desk agents for trade businesses

founders.name: Vamsee Koneru
previous_startups: Unnamed bootstrapped edtech company with about 4 million USD annual revenue, exited (company claim on YC page, unverified)
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a two-time edtech entrepreneur with experience in India, MENA and the UK. CB Insights lists Startup Leadership Program, Yardstick Educational Initiatives, Tech Mahindra and Atlas Copco, not confirmed from a primary source, so not recorded as employers. Education not found.

competitors.name: Smith.ai
competitors.what: Hybrid AI and live receptionist call answering for small businesses
competitors.funding_then: 5 million USD on 2021-03-01, total about 11.96 million USD per CB Insights

competitors.name: Ruby Receptionists
competitors.what: Live answering service for small businesses, the traditional call center type the YC launch post positions against
competitors.traction_then: described later as serving over 14,000 businesses (undated)

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents that triage, schedule and quote for trades needed telephony and speech integration in early 2022, before large language model voice stacks made it routine.

defensibility.rationale: AI answering is widely copyable and many vendors entered later; trade specific tuning and integrations are the only stated edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many AI receptionist vendors for home services emerged and field service tools integrated with them. No acquisition of SpadeWorks found.

market_need_then: The YC launch post says contractors lose revenue when they cannot answer calls during jobs. Independent demand measures for 2022 were not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses spadeworks.co, not a .com; the site did not resolve from the research environment

identity.voice_and_tone: Revenue focused, 'turn every call into revenue'

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found, and the name is confusable with Spade, another YC W22 company.

outcome_analysis: SpadeWorks is listed as active with 13 people in Hyderabad and a current pitch of AI agents for trade contractors, which is a product framing shaped by the 2023 to 2025 wave of voice AI. Funding beyond the YC deal is not found, so runway and traction are unknown. The category became crowded with AI receptionists, and no outcome news was found.
notes: Company website www.spadeworks.co failed to resolve (host not reachable from the session), so it is not read. Unverified: CB Insights shows 500K convertible note, investors Y Combinator, Eight Capital Group and ISM Angel, while another CB Insights page shows 3.57M total possibly mixed with Skillbee; not recorded as rounds. The YC page also describes the founder's edtech exit with no named company. No shutdown or acquisition news found.
